page.layout: Top: running head centred and page number at top right. Below, two round portrait medallions side by side, each with its inscription around the rim (left: HOSIVS / POLON. EPISC.; right: DOCTOR. NAVARRVS. / MAR. AZPIL. / CVETA). Below them one column of running text in two paragraphs. Signature at foot right.

main_text.p: STANISLAVS Hosius,Cardinalis Polonus,Episcopus Vuarmensis, legatus Romani Pontificis, & Præses in Concilio Tridentino,vir doctissimus, & fidei catholicæ accerrimus propugnator Scripsit Confessione fidei sæpius impressam & ab auctore nunc demum ita auctā,ut nouū opus videri possit. Hæc est tanti momenti, ut etiā è Latino in Gallicū idioma conuersa sit nuperrime à Ioanne de Lauardin. Scripsit præterea de expresso Dei verbo: Dialogum num calice laicis,& uxores sacerdotibus permitti fas sit : & plura alia. Viuit adhuc Romæ,cum supradicto Azpilcueta.

MARTINVS ab Azpilcueta doctor Nauarrus, insignis & literarū cognitione præstās, pietatis obseruatissimus,& iuris Pontificij cōsultissimus, ita ut in prælegendo & interpretando eo iure in celebri Academia Corymbricensi, primū locū obtinuerit,laudis alienæ minime cupidus: cū dicat in quadam epistola, huius usurpationem esse veluti notā furti, ut ait Iurisconf. in l. hæreditatum. §. fin. ff. ad l. falc. Is iam octogenarius, magno studio & labore proprio, versioni sui Enchiridij siue Manualis Confessariorū & Pœnitentiū, incubuit:cum multi pro sua in Deū & republica pietate,& in authore beneuolentia, Latinè, Hispanéque callētes, sacræque Theologiæ & utriusque iuris professores id præstare vellent, bonāque iam parte prestitissent:verū id non fecit gloriæ causa, sed ut plenius satisfaceret Reip. Christianæ, & quā plurimis utriusque Hesperiæ viris,erudita pietate claris, auctoritate Pontificia Reuerendiss. imo & Cardinalitia dignitate illustriss.ad id eū vehementer exortatibus. Scripsit tractatum de edditibus beneficiorū,super ca. Quicquid 16.q 1.quo docetur quibus usibus sint impedēdi, & quibus personis dādi aut relinquēdi:de finibus humanorū actuū,tractatū:& plures alios libros ex quibus vir dignitate clarus non mediocrē laudem meretur.

page.notes: Medallion inscriptions set around the portraits, transcribed from the rim. The printed text is set in roman with some italic passages. Doubtful readings: "de edditibus" (the word after "tractatum" is hard to read, could be "de additibus") and "versioni" (final letter uncertain). "propugnato·r" has a dot between the syllables and no space before "Scripsit" in the print; I have written "propugnator Scripsit". Printed "posiit" and "vt", "vsurpationem" and similar long-s or u/v forms are normalised as the rules direct, so "possit" appears in the transcription. Long s shows as f-like in the scan and is read as s throughout.
